notes.title: First Announcment
notes.content:
[h1]It Begins![/h1]

Wanted to come here and say thank you for playing the demo (to those who have). The game is still in development and I want to use the demo as a place to connect with you, the player, as I work out the main game. 

Today I just updated the demo with some a few simple cut scenes to better explore of Happy Corp. lore.

Don't forget to leave a review, and help push the game through the algorithm.
